Inspecteur,\n\nLa commission d'avancemen:
Inspector,

The promotion board has reviewed your first files. It proposes your appointment to the rank of Inspector, 2nd class, with access to the confidential archives.

The appointment takes effect on Monday if you accept it. A refused appointment will not be offered again for a long time.

R. MAZUR

Inspector,

The promotion board proposes your appointment to the rank of Inspector, 2nd class. I must tell you that the recommendation of the District 9 Militia captain weighed more than your files.

Accept if you wish. But you will know whom you owe it to, and so will he.

R. MAZUR

Inspector,

The promotion board has reviewed your first files. You remain at the rank of Inspector, 3rd class.

R. MAZUR
Nomination enregistrée. Votre nouvelle c: Appointment recorded. Your new card will be waiting for you at the secretariat on Monday.
Vous signez la mention « décline la prop: You sign the line "declines the proposal". MAZUR puts the sheet away without a word. On the way out, you pass KREMER on the archive stairs; he nods to you.
